_: Production companies whose name on a title tells a viewer something about its taste: a house style, or a
curation people browse by (oxyc/den#132). The store build writes this list beside the per-title
`companies` column (store/studios.py), so a reader knows which studios to link and give a row.
Kept by hand because no measure finds them all. Plot similarity and shared makers catch the animation
houses, but score A24, Searchlight, Focus, Neon and Annapurna the same as Universal: those labels share
a sensibility, not stories or people. See the measurement on oxyc/den#132.
Left out on purpose: distributors, financiers and holding companies (Warner Bros., StudioCanal, The Walt
Disney Company); IP owners, which the franchise rows cover (Hasbro, Lego); and one director's or star's
own company, which a person page covers (Malpaso, Happy Madison, El Deseo, CoMix Wave).
`qid` is the studio's Wikidata item and the id a page is addressed by. `also` lists the other items the
facts credit for the SAME studio: a renamed item, a duplicate, or its own television or animation arm.
A parent company or a namesake is not one of them. `name` is what a viewer calls the studio, which is
not always Wikidata's label (Orange Sky Golden Harvest is Golden Harvest). `why` is the taste the name
